transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function for the Rust 1.96 target body.
Adapted the inherent immutable `[u8]` receiver to an explicit `slice: &[u8]` parameter, removed `const`, and named the return value for Verus; no target-body path was externalized or assumed.
Lowered unsupported `[first, rest @ ..]` matching to a break-preserving loop over `bytes.len()`, `bytes.split_at(1)`, `&head[0]`, and `bytes = rest` when the leading byte is ASCII whitespace.

Instantiated the audited ASCII whitespace and trim-start vocabulary locally, including the boundary/index/result relation and proof-only split/subrange assertions needed to prove `ascii_trim_start_result` from the executable loop.

Replaced the external lemma_ascii_trim_start_index_matches_boundary with a verified uniqueness proof: two trim-start boundaries cannot have different indices, and choose therefore returns the loop-computed boundary index.
